selection: First accessible subject in numeric order, starting subject1; do not choose using measured HR error
scope: initial independent-recording feasibility check, not population validation
primary_reference: dominant frequency of synchronized contact PPG in each identical 30-second window; fixed same Welch and band
quality: ratio_threshold 1.2; separation .15Hz; edge margin .05Hz; no fitting
error_event_for_exploratory_flag_table: absolute HR difference >5 BPM; threshold fixed before external outcome
report: all windows, failures, coverage and error; no post hoc threshold changes
protocol_amendment_before_signal_access: Dataset authors readme says they evaluate contact-PPG-derived HR, not sensor HR. Amended before downloading/inspecting any subject waveform or video.
